morphology_constructions.input: pure numeral ending in -shat or vimshati in PG789's same-unit surplus relation
morphology_constructions.action: select ḍa and remove the licensed final ṭi portion

morphology_constructions.input: integral x:1 equal-portion value or reciprocal exchange, x greater than one
morphology_constructions.action: select mayat and agree with the item qualified

source_policy_decisions.decision: Apply 5.2.46 only to actual numerals. Lexical compounds gotrimshat and govimshati do not enter merely by their final letters.
Require an integral x:1 ratio with x greater than one. Reject x:2, one-to-one, fractional and mixed-item pseudo-ratios.
Retain both source-authorized directions: the value-measure nimana and the reciprocally measured nimeya. Do not collapse their commodity roles.

open_or_blocked: Complete paradigms, accent, wider barter vocabulary and historical price systems remain Open.
Generic multiplicative or cooking uses do not satisfy the 5.2.47 exchange guard.
The ordinal family beginning at 5.2.48 is a separate unconstructed block.
